EMAIL.description: Cloudflare Email Service, which sends Ember's email once your account is on Workers Paid and has a domain onboarded to Email Sending.

FILES.description: The R2 bucket for the files people upload to rooms. Any name works; the deploy creates it if your account has none by that name.

STORAGE_BACKEND.description: Where messages live. Keep `do-sqlite`, which needs nothing more; `d1` also needs a D1 database bound as `DB` (see the README).
